title.ko: 민주캄푸치아 시기 범죄의 기소에 관한 국제연합·캄보디아 협정 (2003년 6월 6일)
title.en: Agreement between the United Nations and the Royal Government of Cambodia concerning the Prosecution under Cambodian Law of Crimes Committed during the Period of Democratic Kampuchea (6 June 2003)

description.ko: 캄보디아 특별재판소(ECCC)를 세운 국제연합과 캄보디아 왕국 정부의 협정 전문 32개 조. 재판 대상을 1975~1979년 범죄의 민주캄푸치아 고위 지도자와 가장 큰 책임자로 한정하고, 캄보디아인 판사 다수·국제 판사 소수의 재판부와 가중 다수결, 공동 수사판사·공동 검사 제도를 정했다.
description.en: Full text of the 32-article agreement between the United Nations and the Royal Government of Cambodia that set up the Extraordinary Chambers (ECCC). It limits prosecution to senior leaders of Democratic Kampuchea and those most responsible for crimes of 1975–1979, and fixes chambers with a Cambodian majority and international minority, a supermajority voting rule, and paired co-investigating judges and co-prosecutors.

source: Agreement between the United Nations and the Royal Government of Cambodia concerning the Prosecution under Cambodian Law of Crimes Committed during the Period of Democratic Kampuchea, Phnom Penh, 6 June 2003 (approved by UN General Assembly resolution 57/228 B of 13 May 2003; in force 29 April 2005; United Nations Treaty Series, vol. 2329, No. 41723). 저본: 영어 정본, ECCC 게시본 https://www.eccc.gov.kh/sites/default/files/legal-documents/Agreement_between_UN_and_RGC.pdf (2026-10-07 접근). 국제기구·정부 간 조약으로 저작권 보호 대상 아님.

en: Agreement concerning the Prosecution under Cambodian Law of Crimes Committed during the Period of Democratic Kampuchea
